quote: the help of the tanks of "B" Squadron of the 6th Armoured Regiment was invaluable
note: D.D. tanks landed on the Courseulles beaches (Mike sector) with 7th Brigade; B Sqn helped the Reginas at the East Courseulles strongpoint

quote: Assistance was asked from the 6th Armoured Regiment
note: Advance held up by machine-gun fire in front of Ste. Croix; tanks beat down the opposition

quote: through Camilly to the north edge of Secqueville-en-Bessin
note: Only one troop of C Sqn (Lt. W. F. McCormick), which then turned back; furthest point reached, not where the regiment was

quote: the whole of the 6th Armoured Regiment harboured at Pierrepont
note: Night harbour of 6/7 June, in the 7th Brigade area (planned harbour had been Beny-sur-Mer--Basly)

quote: with "B" Squadron supporting the Queen's Own
note: D.D. tanks in the assault on Nan White, Bernières, with the Queen's Own Rifles

quote: and "C" Squadron the North Shore
note: C Sqn with the North Shore Regiment at St. Aubin; the text names the regiment but not the beach for each squadron, the place follows the battalion

quote: pushed southward towards Beny-sur-Mer, supported by "A" Squadron
note: A Sqn with the advance from Bernières south toward Bény-sur-Mer; regiment's night position not given

quote: had run into other resistance at Villons-les-Buissons
note: Advanced guard of 9th Brigade with the North Nova Scotia Highlanders from 6:20 p.m., via Colomby-sur-Thaon

quote: The infantry and tanks accordingly formed a fortress
note: Night of 6/7 June, dug in with the North Novas in the area Anisy--Villons-les-Buissons

quote: the commanders of the 8th and 9th Infantry Brigades and the 2nd Armoured Brigade
note: Only the brigade commander is placed: at General Keller's 2:35 p.m. conference at 3rd Division HQ, Bernières. Brigade HQ location not given

quote: Between the two villages the infantry dismounted from their tanks, which pushed on alone.
note: Tanks of the 9th Bde advanced guard (27th Armd Regt with North Nova Scotias) pushed past Authie toward Carpiquet.

quote: The 27th Armoured Regiment's Stuarts had reported themselves in Franqueville, close to Carpiquet.
note: Recce troop Stuarts reached Franqueville before the German counter-attack.

quote: several surviving tanks of the Sherbrooke Fusiliers recovered the village.
note: Fierce tank battle south of Buron against 12th SS; Sherbrookes helped retake Buron at dusk.

quote: the North Nova Scotias and the Sherbrooke Fusiliers now joined with them
note: Fell back at dusk to Les Buissons to form a 9th Brigade 'fortress'.

quote: supported by a squadron of the 6th Armoured Regiment
note: Evening 7 June: a squadron sent with a Canadian Scottish company to fill the gap in the Cairon area.

quote: The Scottish were given strong support: a squadron of the 6th Armoured Regiment;
note: Squadron supported the Canadian Scottish counter-attack that retook Putot on the evening of 8 June.

quote: clearing in succession the villages of Cairon, Lasson and Rosel
note: A squadron supported No. 46 RM Commando clearing the Mue valley villages.

quote: Fort Garry tanks as well as a company of the Chaudières
note: Evening fighting at Le Hamel and Rots in support of No. 46 RM Commando.

quote: to attack through Norrey-en-Bessin
note: Hussars and Queen's Own Rifles attacked south through Norrey toward the high ground south of Cheux.

quote: Both the tanks and a party of infantry fought their way into Le Mesnil-Patry.
note: 'B' Squadron led with QOR 'D' Company riding on its tanks and was virtually annihilated; 80 casualties.

quote: an enterprise by the 2nd Canadian Armoured Brigade south of Norrey-en-Bessin
note: Brigade operation launched at short notice; 6th Armd Regt and QOR attacked Le Mesnil-Patry.
